llms.body:
# GIGABYTE
> GIGABYTE is a global technology company delivering computing products and infrastructure for consumers, businesses, and data centers. Its portfolio spans PCs and components, AI and server systems, rack-scale infrastructure, advanced cooling, and edge computing, supporting workloads from gaming and content creation to AI, HPC, cloud, and next-generation data centers.

## Important GIGABYTE Business Categories
- **AI & HPC** Accelerated computing infrastructure for AI training, inference, and high-performance computing.
- **Servers & Data Center** Server platforms and infrastructure for enterprise, cloud, storage, AI, and data center workloads.
- **Advanced Cooling** Direct liquid cooling and immersion cooling for high-density computing environments.
- **Consumer Computing** Motherboards, graphics cards, laptops, monitors, PC components, storage, and peripherals.
- **Embedded & Edge Computing** Computing platforms for industrial, edge AI, AIoT, and telecommunications applications.
- **Software** Management and orchestration tools for systems, clusters, and computing infrastructure.
